page.notes: Long s normalised to plain s throughout (e.g. "fpectaculum", "fervitutem", "Triftari" read as spectaculum, servitutem, Tristari). Catchword "ftare" read as "stare". Running head includes the date 1639 as printed; page number 341 is printed at top right. The text ends mid-word with the printed hyphen "pote-", completed by the catchword.
